scenes.name: Act 1 - Welcome to the Brain Candy Lab

shots.name: Shot 1.1 - Candy Factory Exterior
shots.setup: Wide establishing shot, EXT. BRAIN CANDY LAB - MORNING.
shots.description: A colorful factory shaped like a giant brain sits atop a hill, with candy-colored smoke drifting from whimsical chimneys and tiny robots delivering glowing lollipops.
shots.dialogue: Narrator: 'Hidden beyond the ordinary world stood the famous Brain Candy Lab.'
shots.notes: Playful, saturated colors. Slow crane shot.

shots.name: Shot 1.2 - Meet Professor Fizzlebop
shots.setup: Medium shot, INT. MAIN LAB - DAY.
shots.description: Professor Fizzlebop, a wild-haired scientist wearing oversized goggles, juggles bubbling beakers while chewing neon gum that sparks tiny lightning bolts.
shots.dialogue: Professor Fizzlebop: 'Science should always be a little delicious!'
shots.notes: Comedic timing with exaggerated facial expressions.

shots.name: Shot 1.3 - The Secret Recipe
shots.description: A glowing recipe card labeled 'Brain Candy Formula 42½' floats above a swirling candy cauldron.
shots.dialogue: Professor Fizzlebop: 'Just one tiny pinch of imagination...'
shots.notes: Soft magical glow and floating particles.

shots.name: Shot 2.1 - Unexpected Reaction
shots.setup: Medium wide shot, INT. TEST KITCHEN - DAY.
shots.description: The bubbling mixture suddenly erupts into colorful clouds shaped like cartoon brains wearing sunglasses.
shots.notes: Fast zoom with comic sound effects.

shots.name: Shot 2.2 - Dancing Brain Candy
shots.setup: Tracking shot, INT. LAB FLOOR - DAY.
shots.description: Tiny pieces of Brain Candy hop off conveyor belts and begin dancing in synchronized choreography.
shots.notes: Playful camera movement following the dancing candy.

shots.name: Shot 2.3 - Genius Overload
shots.description: One candy lands on Professor Fizzlebop's tongue, causing equations, doodles, and inventions to rapidly appear around his head as holograms.
shots.dialogue: Professor Fizzlebop: 'I just invented reversible toast!'

shots.name: Shot 3.1 - Runaway Conveyor
shots.setup: Wide shot, INT. FACTORY FLOOR - DAY.
shots.description: Conveyor belts twist through the laboratory as runaway Brain Candy bounces everywhere, activating strange inventions.
shots.notes: Dynamic handheld feel with exaggerated action.

shots.name: Shot 3.2 - Bubble Brain Storm
shots.setup: High angle shot, INT. CENTRAL ATRIUM - DAY.
shots.description: Gigantic floating bubbles filled with colorful ideas drift through the lab while scientists chase them with butterfly nets.
shots.dialogue: Professor Fizzlebop: 'Catch the good ideas before they float away!'

shots.name: Shot 3.3 - Candy Cannon
shots.setup: Medium action shot, INT. INVENTION BAY - DAY.
shots.description: Fizzlebop aims a gigantic candy cannon that fires marshmallow confetti, slowing the runaway Brain Candy.
shots.notes: Slow motion as colorful candy fills the frame.

shots.name: Shot 4.1 - The Perfect Formula
shots.setup: Medium shot, INT. MAIN LAB - SUNSET.
shots.description: Professor Fizzlebop carefully adds one final sparkling ingredient, calming the glowing Brain Candy into perfect harmony.
shots.dialogue: Professor Fizzlebop: 'Every great experiment needs just the right amount of wonder.'
shots.notes: Warm golden lighting with magical sparkle.

shots.name: Shot 4.2 - Happy Ending
shots.setup: Wide hero shot, INT. BRAIN CANDY LAB - SUNSET.
shots.description: Scientists, robots, and cheerful Brain Candy celebrate together beneath a glowing rainbow made of colorful neural pathways.
shots.dialogue: Narrator: 'And from that day on, every brilliant idea began with a little Brain Candy.'
shots.notes: Epic pullback ending with whimsical orchestral feel.
